title: AI Interviewer — Voice-First Mock Interviews
description: A live AI interviewer that reads your resume and target role, then runs a voice-to-voice mock interview with real follow-ups instead of a fixed question list. Pick focus, rigor and duration, and finish with a graded report scored question by question.

title: Git Vault — GitHub as Media Storage
description: Turns any GitHub repository into a free media bucket. Authenticate with GitHub, drag-and-drop uploads with automatic image compression, browse a real gallery, and generate permanent CDN links — with multi-branch support, folder management, and full Git version history.

title: CVremix — AI Resume Tailor & ATS Optimizer
description: AI resume optimizer that tailors your CV to any job description to pass Applicant Tracking Systems. Four rewriting strategies, before/after ATS match scoring, keyword-gap analysis, a CAR bullet optimizer, and six ATS-safe templates — no sign-up, nothing stored.

title: AI Bazaar — AI Marketplace with Negotiation
description: An AI-powered marketplace that brings bazaar-style haggling online. An AI assistant helps shoppers find products across 50,000+ items in 18 departments, then buyers chat the price down with the seller — agreed prices lock for 10 minutes to complete checkout.

title: RigForge — AI-Powered PC Builder
description: Describe your needs in plain language ("4K editing + gaming, quiet, ~₹1.2L") and get three compatibility-guaranteed builds — Value, Balanced, and Performance — from a 2,300+ part catalog. A deterministic solver picks parts while AI handles interpretation and explanation, with 3D build previews.

title: logger-logs — Zero-Dependency Node Logger
description: A fast, zero-dependency structured logger for Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript published to npm. Log levels, JSON and pretty output, file & line numbers, child loggers, async context, rotating file transport, and automatic secret redaction — all in a tiny package with no runtime dependencies.

title: UU2 — AI B2B Marketplace
description: AI-powered B2B marketplace connecting Malaysian vendors with global buyers. Built the customer-facing website and the admin panel, with intelligent vendor matching and verified-vendor workflows.

title: Boundless Giving — Charity Marketplace
description: Social-impact e-commerce marketplace where 10–70% of every sale goes to vetted charities. Curated fashion, beauty, and home goods with automatic donation flows at checkout.

title: Instacoach — AI Baseball Coach
description: AI baseball-training app that builds personalized, equipment-aware workouts for hitting, pitching, and arm care — on-demand sessions with adaptive programming and progress tracking.

title: FotoRus — Camera & Photo Editor
description: All-in-one camera and photo-editing app (4.3★ on the App Store) featuring a collage maker, real-time beauty camera, filters, stickers, and picture-in-picture effects across iOS and Android.

title: Besteon — Solar Wholesale Platform
description: B2B photovoltaic (solar) wholesale distribution platform for the renewable-energy market — product catalog and ordering built for a European solar-equipment distributor.

title: Smart Commerce Platform
description: AI-powered multivendor e-commerce with natural-language product search, an intelligent price-negotiation agent, and personalized recommendations.

title: Resume Optimizer SaaS
description: AI resume-tailoring system using LLM agents — improves ATS matching with keyword optimization and prompt engineering. Cut manual resume effort by 70%.

title: Social Networking App
description: Real-time social platform with messaging, notifications, and dynamic updates built on WebSockets.

title: LLM Document Q&A
description: Document question-answering system built at Eqaim using layered prompt pipelines over large document corpora.

title: AI Content Moderation
description: Content-moderation service detecting unsafe media — production system serving concurrent users.
